Snip Snap 0.6.1 Beta 266 — Mac
- Fix a #365 regression that stopped in-flight snips syncing, and keep superseded seed approvals off iCloud - Record a failed CLI session end as cli.session_end - Don't swap in an empty store when a mode change's candidate files are gone - Keep a stored marker so an interrupted clipboard account reset still blocks the next account after a relaunch - Offer Try Again when a deletion is incomplete - Give the legacy text record's reached-iCloud rule one home - Don't let Try Again replay a full re-enable merge in flight, and keep its plan digest stable - Record and report a failed Try Again in Deletion incomplete

Snip Snap 0.6.1 Beta 257 — Mac
- Let tests drive the CloudKit record transport's lifecycle - Make the CloudKit record transport lifecycle explicit - Make outbound send admission and mailbox delivery explicit - Give the Mac clipboard write one owner with per-write tokens - Record crashes and system kills in the diagnostics export - Keep write admission closed until a reservation clear reaches disk - Make diagnostics settings, writer, and background activity explicit state machines - Give inline snip editing one owner on the Mac - Stop a clipboard upload in flight when iCloud sync turns off - Give global shortcut registration one explicit state - Make the generated Markdown export lifetime an explicit state machine - Show letters and an automatic color for lists without an icon - Give deleted-list composer redirection one owner - Keep search focus after an edit and give Mac search mode one owner - Release write admission after any failed library write - Give import coalescing, the account choice, and toast timing explicit phases - Give app sync requests one explicit queue machine - Make the collection reset lifecycle explicit and stop a finished delete from overriding sync results - Keep clipboard sync working after another device resets the sync generation - Finish a failed Apple Account isolation without relaunch, as an explicit state machine - Make attachment publication, cleanup, and download installation explicit state machines - Record Mac copies made while clipboard history is set aside - Give glass menus and expandable text one transition owner - Store an account-isolation choice only after its swap finishes - Keep downloaded attachments syncing and openable after a metadata edit - Set aside unbound clipboard history on an account change when clipboard sync is on - Clear "Deletion incomplete" once a sync request shows Delete Synced Content finished - Make the sync-mode transition one explicit state machine and let Try Again recover a stranded change - Make iCloud enrollment explicit and stop endless zone re-saves - Keep memory-only clipboard entries when a set-aside follows a failed save - Give the sync engine session and corrupt-record recovery explicit machines, and stop recovery deleting delivered records - Make a user's Keep and a background status take turns on the Keep merge - Keep attachments consistent when they change while their iCloud operations are in flight - Let sync-mode Try Again finish only a rollback this process couldn't commit - Turn sync off when a stop's cleanup fails - Keep enrollment edge cases in defined states after SM27, and fix the #354 payload-only fetch regression - Record a failed CLI suspend as cli.scope_suspend - Say existing clipboard history will upload when clipboard sync turns on - Keep pruning clipboard files after an undecodable set-aside copy - Preserve a returning account's attachments inside the Keep's turn - Keep clipboard history out of the next account after a failed account reset
